items: 【Rechargeable, 6000mAh large capacity battery, continuous operation for 150 minutes 】 The outdoor shower kit has a battery capacity of 6000mAh, which can be fully charged in 4-6 hours and can work continuously for 150 minutes. Our portable camping shower is charged through a TYPE-C charging cable and can be charged using a mobile phone charger (5V-2A), power bank, laptop, AC adapter, car USB, and other devices, making it very convenient.

【Intelligent digital display】 The portable camping shower kit has intelligent LED digital display function, which can clearly display the current remaining power and water temperature (range 50-140 ° F/10-60 ° C). Note:Noheatingfunction. This portable shower kit has high power mode/low energy saving mode. When turned on,the default mode is high mode and lights up green.The water flow will be larger.When the kit switch button is pressed,it will switch to low mode and light up red

【multipurpose】 Portable shower head have a wide range of applications, including outdoor bathing,car camping, dog shower, car washing, washing dishes and vegetables, watering plants,There are camping essentials

【Lightweight and easy to carry】 The camp shower kit includes 1x multi-mode shower head, 1x spray gun head, 1x electric water kit, 1x 6.7-foot water pipe, 1x multi-purpose hook, 1x Type-C charging cable, and a mesh storage bag for easy carrying and storage. The entire package measures 11 * 7 * 3 inches and weighs 2pound, making it very lightweight and portable, suitable for outdoor activities.

【Adjustable water flow】 The electric shower head is equipped with a STOP knob, which can be turned to adjust the water output (up to 8L/min). It can also freely control the opening and closing of water flow by pressing the stop button.
